comment: Test pool machines (tools/remote/pool.mjs, docs/worktrees.md 'Test pool'). Override per machine with the "pool" key of the gitignored lf.local.json. A machine with "lanes" runs tests and sessions apart: the session lane is the server-2001 lock on UDP 2001 (sessions, host, serve; clients join it), each test lane is its own server-test-<k> lock with a server on 127.0.0.1:2001+k (-addr). Without "lanes" a machine keeps one shared lane of "slots" servers on 2001. sessionIdleMin: a session idle this long while a job waits is closed. promoteMin: a queued job moves up one priority level per this many minutes. minFreeMb: a second concurrent server waits while free RAM is under this. bootBudgetS: a server not ready by then is killed (exit 124). A machine's budgetMultiplier scales the seeded run budgets and the boot budget (the laptop is about 2x slower). sessionHoldMin: a session started after the cap existed that is older than this while another session request queues is warned, then closed sessionGraceMin later (session up --hold <min> raises its own, to sessionHoldMaxMin); with nobody queued there is no cap. lf-testbox (ROG Zephyrus G15: Ryzen 9 6900HS 8c/16t, RTX 3070 Ti, 47 GB RAM) measured 2026-11-10: server 0.7 GB working set, one client 0.6-1.0 GB, a server plus one client drops free RAM by 1.2 GB, a test server about 0.7 GB; 33 GB free with a maintainer Workbench (1.7 GB, more with a world loaded) and Steam running. 3 session + 3 test lanes: about 6 GB sessions + 2 GB tests, leaving 4+ GB for one Workbench and the 1.5 GB floor. "hostname" is the machine hostname: on that machine its own entry is the local one (lanes, floor gate), not this PC's.
